name: pey.filesystem
description: User-device file access: pick files/folders, list Markdown entries, read and write through File System Access handles (with capability flags for fallback paths)

provides.name: pey.filesystem.service
provides.description: Portable file-entry operations over environment pickers and handles. Pickers are injected by the caller (the plugin never touches the DOM); entries carry either a FileSystem handle or a plain File.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Reports which environment pickers exist and whether picked entries can be written back.
methods.returns: { directoryPicker: boolean, filePicker: boolean, writable: boolean }

methods.name: pickDirectory
methods.description: Opens the injected directory picker and returns the chosen folder as an entry. Null when no picker is available or the user cancels.

params.name: picker
params.type: function | null — environment directory picker (e.g. window.showDirectoryPicker) or null

methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemDirectoryHandle } | null

methods.name: pickFile
methods.description: Opens the injected file picker and returns the chosen file as an entry. Null when no picker is available or the user cancels.

params.name: picker
params.type: function | null — environment file picker (e.g. window.showOpenFilePicker) or null

methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemFileHandle } | null

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Walks a directory handle recursively and returns every Markdown entry with its relative path and own file handle. Flat list; other files are skipped.
methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemFileHandle }[]

methods.name: collectEntries
methods.description: Filters a flat file list (e.g. from a webkitdirectory input) down to Markdown entries, keeping each file for reading.

params.name: files
params.type: Array<File-like> — each with name, text() and optional webkitRelativePath

methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, file: File-like }[]

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Reads entry text through its handle (with a read-permission round-trip) or its plain file. Strips a leading byte-order mark.

params.name: entry
params.type: { name: string, path: string, handle?: FileSystemFileHandle, file?: File-like }

methods.name: writeEntry
methods.description: Writes content through the entry handle (with a readwrite-permission round-trip). Null when the entry has no writable handle — the caller falls back (e.g. to a download).

params.name: entry
params.type: { name: string, path: string, handle?: FileSystemFileHandle }
